name: hmi_patch_json
description: Validate or apply declarative Unified HMI JSON set/bind/delete operations with require and verify guards; changes are transactional, compiled, and never saved. bind only changes the tag of a tag dynamization and never the mapping table; omitted readOnly/useIndirectAddressing keep their current values; expectTag guards the current tag. require.screens[].items must exist before any change. Unknown fields are ignored and reported in warnings. Format: hmi-json skill, section Guarded patch workflow.

file_path.description: Path to a tia-mcp-hmi-patch/1 JSON patch file: {format, require?, verify?, operations: [{op: 'set'|'bind'|'delete', screen, group?, item, ...}]}.

dry_run.description: Validate preconditions and report operations without applying them (default: false).

target_name.description: Target HMI software/device selector (optional when only one target exists).
